The software product **Niah AI** hosted at **askniah.com** is provided and developed by **Kevin Oduor**, operating under the project/brand entity **Niah AI**.

### Evidence and Citations
* **Developer:** Developer listings and profiles identify software builder **Kevin Oduor** as the creator of the tool, cataloged on StackShare under his profile (`kevinoooduor`) for the tech stack of **Niah AI**, as well as in reporting on Kenyan startup founders noting *"AskNiah by Kevin Oduor"*.
* **Entity / Brand:** VC4A directories register the Nairobi, Kenya-based health-tech venture as **Niah AI** (*"Niah AI - Your healthcare companion"*), and directory listings similarly cite the operating name as *"Niah AI Company name: Niah AI"* linked to Kenyan contact channels (`+254...`).
